mentions.name: Nonoverse
mentions.description: A puzzle game that is being expanded with larger puzzles, plus a selective zoom feature where only the board zooms in while the clues around the board remain visible.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Larger puzzles in my puzzle game[1].

And some yak shaving in the form of selective zoom, where only the board would zoom in but the clues around the board would still remain visible.
